id: 10_Donning and Doffing PPE in Clinical Laboratories Removing Gown and Gloves Togeth
title: 隔离衣与手套一起脱
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/10_Donning and Doffing PPE in Clinical Laboratories Removing Gown and Gloves Togeth.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/10_Donning and Doffing PPE in Clinical Laboratories Removing Gown and Gloves Togeth/src.py

points.K4: 备齐隔离衣、手套、口罩、面屏

shots.scene: 欣欣穿着蓝色隔离衣，戴口罩和面屏，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a blue gown, a face mask and a clear face shield and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲隔离衣和手套一起脱。

shots.scene: 隔离衣、手套、口罩、面屏四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a blue gown, a pair of gloves, a face mask and a clear face shield. No people.
shots.narration: 基本防护，加上飞沫防护。

shots.scene: 小研来到临床实验室，今天的操作可能有飞溅
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student arrives at a clinical laboratory where today's work may create splashes and droplets.
shots.narration: 小研今天的操作，可能会有飞溅。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在她身边，竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside her and raises one finger with a friendly smile.
shots.narration: 跟着她，学穿戴和一起脱的方法。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着衣架上的四件装备
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a gown, gloves, a face mask and a face shield laid out on a clean bench.
shots.narration: 本课的装备：基本防护加飞沫防护。

shots.scene: 首饰、手表、手机、包放进实验室外储物柜
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a ring, a watch, a phone and a bag going into a locker outside the lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 摘下首饰手表，外套手机笔包放门外。

shots.scene: 小研把长发束起
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ties her long hair back with a hair tie.
shots.narration: 长发束起来。

shots.section_title: 备齐隔离衣、手套、口罩、面屏
shots.scene: 实心前襟、紧针织袖口的隔离衣特写
shots.prompt_en: A blue solid-front gown that wraps around the back, with knit cuffs highlighted by a circle. No people.
shots.narration: 隔离衣要实心前襟、包绕式、紧袖口。
overlay: 备齐隔离衣、手套、口罩、面屏

shots.section_title: 备齐隔离衣、手套、口罩、面屏
shots.scene: 一副手套、一个医用口罩、一个一次性面屏
shots.prompt_en: One pair of gloves, a flat medical face mask and a disposable face shield on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 一副手套，一次性医用口罩和面屏。

shots.scene: 两种口罩：医用口罩和杯型呼吸器，中间问号
shots.prompt_en: Two masks side by side: a flat medical face mask and a cup-shaped respirator, with a question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 用医用口罩，还是N95呼吸器？

shots.scene: 老周手持空白风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: The older man holds a clipboard with a blank risk assessment form and taps it.
shots.narration: 看实验室和操作的风险评估。

shots.scene: 医用口罩图标被高亮
shots.prompt_en: The flat medical face mask icon is highlighted with a green frame. No people.
shots.narration: 本课演示的是医用口罩。

shots.scene: 小研比对隔离衣和手套的尺码
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks the size of a gown and a glove box with a blank label.
shots.narration: 隔离衣和手套，尺码要合适。

shots.scene: 放大镜检查，撕裂和断带处打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a gown; a tear and a broken strap are marked with red X icons. No people.
shots.narration: 看看有没有撕裂、破洞、系带松脱。

shots.scene: 有缺陷的口罩放到一边，换一个新的
shots.prompt_en: A mask with a broken ear loop is set aside with a red X and a new mask is picked up. No people.
shots.narration: 发现缺陷，就换掉。

shots.scene: 小研穿上隔离衣，系好颈后系带
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on the blue gown and ties the strap behind her neck.
shots.narration: 穿上隔离衣，在颈后系好。

shots.scene: 在腰侧系一个活结
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands tie the waist strap at the side into a simple bow. No people.
shots.narration: 腰带在背后或侧面系上。

shots.scene: 死结图标被打叉，活结图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a tight hard knot crossed out with a red X, and an easy bow with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 别打死结，也别系太紧，好解开。

shots.scene: 小研穿好隔离衣转身展示
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in the fastened gown turns around; it fits well and she can move her arms freely.
shots.narration: 要合身，方便活动。

shots.scene: 日常衣物外露的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a gown that is too small with street clothes showing at the back, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 日常衣物不能露在外面。

shots.scene: 小研把口罩耳挂挂到耳后
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a medical face mask, hooking the ear loops behind her ears.
shots.narration: 戴口罩，耳挂挂在耳后。

shots.scene: 双手食指沿鼻夹两侧向下按压
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: both index fingers press the flexible nose piece down along each side of the nose. No people.
shots.narration: 双手食指按压鼻夹两侧。

shots.scene: 口罩上缘紧贴鼻梁和面颊，绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a mask sealing snugly over the nose bridge and cheeks, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 让口罩上缘贴紧鼻梁和面颊。

shots.scene: 小研拉开面屏头带
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stretches the elastic strap of a disposable face shield.
shots.narration: 戴面屏，先拉开弹力头带。

shots.scene: 头带套在脑后，海绵贴在眉毛上方
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the strap goes behind the head and the foam band rests just above the eyebrows. No people.
shots.narration: 套到脑后，海绵贴在眉毛上方。

shots.scene: 面屏正面，箭头标出前额、下巴和两侧
shots.prompt_en: Front view of a face shield over a mask; arrows mark the forehead, below the chin and both sides of the face. No people.
shots.narration: 要盖住前额，过下巴，包住两侧。

shots.scene: 小研把针织袖口拉到掌心
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls the knit cuff of the gown sleeve down over her palm.
shots.narration: 最后戴手套，先把袖口拉到掌心。

shots.scene: 手套套在袖口外面打勾，塞在里面打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a glove pulled over the knit cuff with a green check, and a glove tucked under the cuff crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 手套套在袖口外面，不是里面。

shots.scene: 示意袖子不会滑出，袖口被手套盖住
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a gloved arm moving; the sleeve stays inside the glove and the cuff stays covered. No people.
shots.narration: 袖子不滑出，袖口也不沾污。

shots.scene: 小研检查手套有没有破洞
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student spreads her gloved fingers and checks the gloves for holes.
shots.narration: 开工前，再查一遍手套。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着两张空白卡片，中间箭头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up two blank cards with different arrows on them.
shots.narration: 下面介绍一种脱卸的方法和顺序。

shots.scene: 从红到绿的渐变条，隔离衣和手套在红端
shots.prompt_en: A color bar from red to green; a gown and glove icon sits at the red end, a face shield and mask near the green end. No people.
shots.narration: 这里演示从最脏到最干净的一种方法。

shots.scene: 空白风险评估表和空白操作规程
shots.prompt_en: A blank risk assessment form next to a blank procedure document. No people.
shots.narration: 其他方法和顺序，因评估、操作和装备而异。

shots.scene: 小研戴着手套解开腰侧系带
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, still wearing gloves, unties the waist strap at her side.
shots.narration: 先脱隔离衣，解开腰带。

shots.scene: 戴手套的双手抓住两肩，向前拉
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student grasps the gown at both shoulders with gloved hands and pulls forward.
shots.narration: 戴着手套，抓住两肩向前拉。

shots.scene: 颈后系带松开
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the back of the neck: the gown's neck strap comes apart. No people.
shots.narration: 把颈后的系带拉断、松开。

shots.scene: 隔离衣从肩部向前滑下，远离身体
shots.prompt_en: The gown slides forward off her shoulders, held away from her body.
shots.narration: 从肩部往前脱，远离身体。

shots.scene: 隔离衣外面朝内卷起的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a gown being rolled so that its outside folds inward. No people.
shots.narration: 边脱边卷，让外面翻到里面。

shots.scene: 手臂从袖子里往外抽
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student draws her arms back out of the sleeves while the gown hangs in front of her.
shots.narration: 手臂往外抽时，先别全脱。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手捏住另一只手套和袖口一起往下拉
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: one gloved hand pinches the other glove together with the sleeve cuff and peels them off together. No people.
shots.narration: 捏住手套连同袖口，一起剥下来。

shots.scene: 两只手套都留在袖子里
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: both gloves come off inside the sleeves, leaving clean bare hands. No people.
shots.narration: 手套留在袖子里，双手干净出来。

shots.scene: 隔离衣和手套卷成里朝外的一团
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the gown and gloves are rolled inside out into one tight bundle. No people.
shots.narration: 连衣带手套，里朝外卷成一团。

shots.scene: 衣团外面碰到手臂和日常衣物的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dirty gown bundle touching a bare arm and street clothes, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 脏的外面，别碰裸手和日常衣物。

shots.scene: 衣团丢进生物危害废物桶
shots.prompt_en: The bundle drops into a red lined pedal bin marked with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 整团丢进生物危害废物容器。

shots.scene: 小研用速干手消毒剂搓手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rubs alcohol hand rub from a pump bottle with a blank label into her hands.
shots.narration: 用含醇速干手消毒剂给双手消毒。

shots.scene: 手消毒剂瓶旁两个百分比图标
shots.prompt_en: The hand rub bottle with two percent sign icons beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 乙醇至少60%，或异丙醇70%。

shots.scene: 三个图标：手消毒、洗手、新手套
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with slashes between them: a hand rub bottle, a sink with soap, and a new pair of gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 也可以洗手，或换一副新手套。

shots.scene: 小研头微微前倾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tilts her head slightly forward, still wearing the face shield and mask.
shots.narration: 摘面屏，头稍微前倾。

shots.scene: 双手捏住耳朵上方的头带向上提
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: both hands hold the elastic strap above the ears and lift the face shield up and away. No people.
shots.narration: 捏住耳朵上方的头带，轻轻提起。

shots.scene: 手碰面屏前片的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of fingers touching the front of a face shield, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别碰面屏前片，那里可能有污染。

shots.scene: 面屏丢进生物危害废物桶
shots.prompt_en: The face shield drops into the lined biohazard pedal bin. No people.
shots.narration: 丢进生物危害废物容器。

shots.scene: 小研双手取下耳挂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes the mask by lifting both ear loops off her ears.
shots.narration: 摘口罩，只拿耳挂。

shots.scene: 手碰口罩正面的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand grabbing the front of a face mask, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不碰口罩外面。

shots.scene: 口罩离开面部，丢进废物桶
shots.prompt_en: The mask, held by its ear loops, is moved away from the face and dropped into the biohazard bin. No people.
shots.narration: 移开后，丢进生物危害废物容器。

shots.scene: 小研用肥皂和流水洗手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student washes her hands with soap under running water.
shots.narration: 最后，用肥皂和流水洗手。

shots.scene: 泡沫双手，手背指缝指甲下被圈出
shots.prompt_en: Soapy hands with the backs, the spaces between fingers and under the nails circled. No people.
shots.narration: 手背、指缝、指甲下，至少搓20秒。

shots.scene: 洗手池打大勾，手消毒剂瓶打小勾
shots.prompt_en: A sink with soap and a large green check, and a hand rub bottle with a smaller check. No people.
shots.narration: 肥皂和水最好，没有时临时用手消。

shots.scene: 包头鞋打勾，凉鞋打叉
shots.prompt_en: A closed-toe shoe with a solid upper with a green check and a sandal crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 穿包头、鞋面不透水的鞋。

shots.scene: 空白风险评估表旁边是防护装备图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank risk assessment form with arrows pointing to gown, mask and glove icons. No people.
shots.narration: 防护穿什么，按风险评估来。

shots.scene: 平面图：穿戴区和脱卸区分开
shots.prompt_en: A floor plan showing a donning area and a separate doffing area divided by a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 穿戴区和脱卸区要分开。

shots.scene: 干净防护用品、个人物品和脏防护用品分处两边
shots.prompt_en: Clean gowns and personal bags on one side, used gowns and gloves on the other side, separated by a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 免得干净用品和个人物品被沾污。

shots.scene: 王老师指着墙上空白的流程图
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank procedure chart on the wall.
shots.narration: 各单位流程不同，遵守本单位制度。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现隔离衣、口罩、面屏、手套图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a gown, a mask, a face shield and gloves.
shots.narration: 穿：隔离衣、口罩、面屏、手套。

shots.scene: 手套套在袖口外、活结打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons with green checks: a glove over a knit cuff and an easy bow knot. No people.
shots.narration: 活结好解，手套盖住袖口。

shots.scene: 隔离衣连手套卷成一团的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a gown and gloves rolled together inside out into one bundle. No people.
shots.narration: 脱：衣服手套一起剥，里朝外卷。

shots.scene: 手消毒、面屏、口罩、洗手的顺序图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons linked by arrows: hand rub, face shield, mask, hand washing at a sink. No people.
shots.narration: 手消毒、摘面屏、摘口罩，再洗手。

shots.scene: 欣欣洗完手，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot dries its paws with a paper towel by the sink and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 脱得干净，才算防护到位，下次见！
